tools.name: compare_basket
tools.description: Prices a whole shopping list at each Israeli supermarket chain's online store and ranks the chains: the total for each chain including its delivery fee, the cheapest chain, the items each chain is missing, the date of the prices, and a link that opens the basket on Ramzii. Example list: "חלב 3%\n2 ל

tools.name: match_list
tools.description: Matches each line of a Hebrew shopping list to a product in Ramzii's catalog: the product found for each line, the lines that need the person to choose between close options (with the options), the lines that were not recognised, the date of the catalog, and a link that opens the list on Ramzii. Exa

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Finds products in Ramzii's catalog of Israeli supermarket online stores and gives today's price of each at every chain that sells it, with the cheapest chain, the date of the prices and the product's page on Ramzii. Example queries: "במבה", "קפה נמס עלית".

tools.name: product_prices
tools.description: Gives one product's price at each Israeli supermarket chain's online store, by its barcode: the price per chain, the cheapest chain, the gap between cheapest and dearest, the date of the prices and the product's page on Ramzii. Example barcode: "7290000066318".
